Name: AIR music mod
Author: Sarsayogor
Description:
[b]AIR Music Replacement[/b] is a Stardew Valley music overhaul mod that replaces the game's original soundtrack with songs from the emotional visual novel [i]AIR[/i] by Key. This mod uses SMAPI and Content Patcher and brings a nostalgic and atmospheric feel to your farming life. Music isn't included, instructions in the README

I'll try to improve it if anyone reports any more errors

For any questions/suggestions/petitions comment or DM me on Discord: @sarsayogor
